beats.en: Catch! Here comes the rope!

as.guan: 官人讓一讓，我拋繩下去！

asEn.guan: Make room, sir, I'm throwing the rope down!
asEn.shi: Lend a hand, sir, hold this end!
asEn.tong: Out of the way, kid, don't fall over!
asEn.fu: Stand back, madam, it's packed at the railing!
asEn.seng: Excuse me, Master, the boat's about to hit!
asEn.li: Brother, come on, throw it together!

beats.en: The mast's not down yet!
The rope's long enough, let out more!
Brace it! Brace it with a pole!
I've got it braced! Lower the mast!

beats.text: 方才好險，桅桿差點撞橋。
beats.en: That was close: the mast nearly hit the bridge.

as.guan: 官人看見了？方才好險。

asEn.guan: Did you see, sir? That was close.

beats.text: 都怪拉縴的，只顧埋頭拉。
beats.en: Blame the trackers: heads down, just pulling.
Someone should have called a halt before the bridge.

beats.text: 一船兩三百人，可不是耍的。
beats.en: Two or three hundred aboard: no joke.
Look, the mast is down.

as.guan: 官人瞧，桅桿放倒了。

asEn.guan: Look, sir, the mast is down.

beats.en: Hold the bow, swing her across!
Good! She'll get through!
The rope's rubbed my hands red.
Look! That boat's going to hit the bridge!

as.guan: 官人快看，大船要撞橋了！
as.shi: 相公看那桅桿，要撞上了！
as.seng: 師父念聲佛罷，那船懸了！

asEn.guan: Look, sir, the big boat's about to hit the bridge!
asEn.shi: Look at the mast, sir, it's going to hit!
asEn.fu: Don't be afraid, madam, watch from further back.
asEn.tong: Little one, stand firm, don't go in the water!
asEn.seng: Master, say a prayer: that boat's in trouble!
asEn.li: Brother, go and lend a hand!

beats.en: Drop the mast! Quick, drop it!

beats.text: 篙頂住橋，莫叫船撞上去！
beats.en: Pole against the bridge, don't let her hit!
Push the stern off, don't hit that boat!
My palms are sweating…

beats.text: 你也瞧見了？這河一到橋下就急。
beats.en: You saw it too? The river runs fast under the bridge.

as.guan: 官人也瞧見了？橋下水急。

asEn.guan: You saw it too, sir? The water's fast under the bridge.

beats.en: Narrow river, fast water, and a low bridge.

beats.text: 早該放桅，拉縴的不喊停！
beats.en: We should've dropped the mast; the trackers never called a halt!
Lucky someone braced it with a pole.
Stand back, this horse has a temper!

as.guan: 官人站開些，這馬驚了！
as.jun: 軍爺，幫我擋一擋那轎子！

asEn.guan: Stand back, sir, the horse is spooked!
asEn.shi: Don't come close, sir, this horse kicks!
asEn.fu: Get away, madam, the horse may bolt!
asEn.tong: Kid, keep clear of the hooves!
asEn.seng: Excuse me, Master, the horse won't behave.
asEn.jun: Soldier, help me hold back that sedan!

beats.en: Clear the way! The official's horse is coming down!
My master's sedan! Make way!

beats.text: 下橋的先走，你們退下去！
beats.en: Those coming down go first. Back down, you!
How do we back down carrying a sedan?
A civil official's sedan, fighting for the road.

beats.text: 還沒讓開呢，兩邊都不肯。
beats.en: Still stuck. Neither side will give way.

as.guan: 官人給評評理，誰該讓？

asEn.guan: Sir, you judge: who should give way?

beats.text: 橋面本就窄，兩邊又擺滿了攤。
beats.en: The deck's narrow, and stalls line both sides.

beats.text: 官府也不管管這些攤子。
beats.en: And the authorities never deal with these stalls.
Enough. Let them finish arguing.

beats.text: 這轎子沉，再停就壓斷肩了。
beats.en: This sedan's heavy; stop again and it'll break my shoulder.

as.guan: 官人，叫那馬讓一讓罷。

asEn.guan: Sir, have the horse give way, please.

beats.en: This horse spooks in a crowd.
You in front, keep to the railing!

beats.text: 好好的清明，偏遇上這個。
beats.en: A fine Qingming, and this happens.

beats.text: 後生，你看這橋，底下沒一根柱子。
beats.en: Look at this bridge, lad: not one pier underneath.

as.guan: 官人請看，這橋底下沒一根柱。
as.shi: 相公是讀書人，可知這橋無柱？
as.fu: 娘子瞧，這橋像天上的虹。
as.tong: 小哥兒，這橋像不像一道虹？
as.seng: 師父，這橋無柱，也立得穩。
as.jun: 軍爺可知，這橋是個牢城兵想的？
as.li: 兄弟，這橋全是大木頭搭的。

asEn.guan: See, sir: not one pier under this bridge.
asEn.shi: You're a scholar, sir: did you know this bridge has no piers?
asEn.fu: See, madam, the bridge is like a rainbow in the sky.
asEn.tong: Little one, doesn't this bridge look like a rainbow?
asEn.seng: Master, no piers, and yet it stands firm.
asEn.jun: Soldier, did you know a prison-camp soldier thought this bridge up?
asEn.li: Brother, it's all built of great timbers.

beats.en: No piers? How does it hold?

beats.text: 大木一根根交錯架起，洪水沖不著。
beats.en: Great timbers laid across each other; the floods can't strike it.

beats.text: 怪不得叫虹橋，紅紅的一道。
beats.en: No wonder it's called the Rainbow Bridge: a red arc.

beats.text: 那大船的桅桿，可莫撞上……
beats.en: That big boat's mast, don't let it hit…

beats.text: 這種橋，是青州一個廢卒想的。
beats.en: A discharged soldier in Qingzhou first thought of this kind of bridge.

as.guan: 官人可知，這橋是個廢卒想的？

asEn.guan: Did you know, sir, a discharged soldier thought it up?

beats.text: 一個兵卒，倒有這般巧思。
beats.en: A common soldier, with such a clever idea.

beats.text: 五十年都不壞，後來汴河上都學。
beats.en: Fifty years and never broken; then the whole Bian copied it.

beats.text: 出了東水門七里，就是虹橋。
beats.en: Seven li out of the East Water Gate, there's the Rainbow Bridge.

beats.text: 汴河水漲得猛，有柱的橋年年沖壞。
beats.en: The Bian floods hard; bridges with piers wash out every year.

beats.text: 橋上那麼多人，壓得住麼？
beats.en: So many people on it. Will it hold?
Don't worry, this bridge is very sturdy.

beats.text: 莫碰這馬，是樓上客官的。
beats.en: Don't touch the horse; it belongs to a guest upstairs.

as.guan: 官人也來吃酒？馬交給小的。
as.shi: 相公來飲新酒？樓上有座。
as.seng: 師父，這是酒店，不是齋堂。

asEn.guan: Here to drink too, sir? Leave your horse with me.
asEn.shi: Here for the new wine, sir? There are seats upstairs.
asEn.fu: Don't come close, madam, the horse kicks.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't pull the horse's tail!
asEn.seng: Master, this is a tavern, not a temple hall.
asEn.jun: Don't eye it, soldier; the horse isn't for sale.
asEn.li: Brother, mind the horse for me a while?

beats.en: New wine's in, come and taste!

beats.text: 借過借過，外頭客官的點心！
beats.en: Coming through! Snacks for a guest outside!
Good wine! Another measure!

beats.text: 腳店的酒，也是正店打來的。
beats.en: A small tavern's wine comes from the big licensed house.

beats.text: 這燈箱，到夜裏點上蠟燭。
beats.en: At night we light candles in this lamp-box.

as.guan: 官人夜裏再來，燈箱都亮了。

asEn.guan: Come back at night, sir, when the lamp-box is lit.

beats.text: 十千二字在側面，客官瞧見沒？
beats.en: The words 'Shiqian' are on the side. See them?

beats.text: 門頭的歡門，是新紮起來的。
beats.en: The festive gate over the door is freshly tied.

beats.text: 羊羔酒八十文一角，貴著呢。
beats.en: Lamb wine, eighty cash a measure: dear stuff.

beats.text: 又來了？樓上的客官還沒喝完。
beats.en: Back again? The guest upstairs isn't done drinking.

as.guan: 官人又來了？樓上正熱鬧。

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? It's lively upstairs.

beats.text: 新酒本是中秋前後才賣的。
beats.en: New wine usually goes on sale around mid-autumn.

beats.text: 客官懂行。酒稅重，官家專賣。
beats.en: You know your wine. Wine tax is heavy; the state holds the trade.
Hurry and finish, so we can go home.

beats.text: 莫靠近，這車上的東西碰不得。
beats.en: Keep back. What's on this cart isn't to be touched.

as.guan: 官人莫看，是主家要燒的舊物。
as.shi: 相公莫問，這是元祐的字。
as.tong: 小娃兒走開，這不是耍的。
as.jun: 軍爺，主家吩咐，推出城去。

asEn.guan: Don't look, sir. Old things my master wants burned.
asEn.shi: Don't ask, sir. It's Yuanyou writing.
asEn.fu: Please step aside, madam, the cart's leaving.
asEn.tong: Go away, kid, this isn't a toy.
asEn.jun: Soldier, master's orders: push it out of town.

beats.en: Strings of copper coins on that cart, are they?

beats.text: 哪是錢，是一扇草書屏風。
beats.en: Not coins: a screen of cursive writing.

beats.text: 拿它當苫布，蓋住底下的書。
beats.en: Used as a tarp, to cover the books underneath.
Fine writing. A pity.

beats.text: 主家吩咐，推到城外燒了。
beats.en: Master's orders: push it out of town and burn it.

as.guan: 官人，這是朝廷禁的，小的奉命。

asEn.guan: Sir, the court has banned it. I only follow orders.

beats.text: 城門那邊，也推出一車去。
beats.en: Another cartload went out by the city gate too.
The court's banned it; who'd dare keep any?

beats.text: 這字，怕是蘇學士一路的。
beats.en: This hand looks like Scholar Su's school.
Count them, don't let a scroll go missing.

as.guan: 官人稍候，小的點完就走。

asEn.guan: A moment, sir, I'll finish counting and go.

beats.en: No donkey for this cart; it's all pushing by hand.
Up — steady now!
Hot wine, hot food, to take away too!

as.guan: 官人歇歇腳，熱酒現成的。
as.shi: 相公坐坐，看看河上的船。
as.fu: 娘子買些回去？包好給您。
as.li: 兄弟，一碗熱的，暖暖身子。

asEn.guan: Rest your feet, sir, hot wine's ready.
asEn.shi: Sit a while, sir, and watch the boats.
asEn.fu: Take some home, madam? I'll wrap it.
asEn.tong: Want a bun, little one? It's hot.
asEn.seng: Master, there are plain noodles, hot.
asEn.jun: Soldier, a measure to take with you?
asEn.li: Brother, a hot bowl to warm you up.

beats.en: Your stove's burning well.

beats.text: 燒的是城外驢馱來的炭。
beats.en: It's charcoal the donkeys bring in from the country.

beats.text: 怪不得生意比郊外那家好。
beats.en: No wonder trade's better here than at that place in the country.

beats.text: 灶下幾個爐口，一刻不停。
beats.en: Several fire mouths under the stove, never idle.

beats.text: 又來了？靠河的座，風景好。
beats.en: Back again? The seats by the river have the view.

as.guan: 官人又來了，靠河的座留著呢。

asEn.guan: Back again, sir; I've kept you a seat by the river.

beats.text: 方才那大船，就在你門前過。
beats.en: That big boat went right past your door just now.

beats.text: 客人全跑去看了，桌子都空著。
beats.en: My guests all ran off to look; the tables are empty.
Coming through, cart going uphill!
Herbal drinks! Drinks to quench thirst and ease fatigue!

as.guan: 官人也嘗一盞？草藥熬的。
as.shi: 相公讀書費神，喝盞飲子罷。
as.fu: 娘子，這飲子甜，孩子也愛喝。
as.tong: 小娃兒，一文錢一盞，要不要？
as.li: 兄弟，挑擔累了罷？來一盞。

asEn.guan: A cup for you too, sir? Boiled from herbs.
asEn.shi: Study wears you out, sir; have a cup.
asEn.fu: Madam, it's sweet; children love it too.
asEn.tong: Kid, one cash a cup, want one?
asEn.seng: Master, it's meatless, boiled from herbs.
asEn.jun: Soldier, a cup before the road.
asEn.li: Tired from the load, brother? Have a cup.

beats.en: One cup! I'm dying of thirst.
A few cash a cup, very cheap.

beats.text: 我也來一盞，擔子先放放。
beats.en: One for me too. Let me set the load down.
Herbs boiled all night: just the right taste.

as.guan: 官人又來了？今日熬得正好。

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? Today's brew is just right.

beats.en: Cheaper than wine, and it won't get you drunk.

beats.text: 挑擔的、推車的，都愛來這裏。
beats.en: Porters and carters all like coming here.
Stand clear! This donkey's turned stubborn!

as.guan: 官人恕罪，這畜生不聽使喚。
as.shi: 相公莫笑，這驢就是不走。
as.seng: 師父，借您的佛力，叫牠走罷。

asEn.guan: Pardon, sir, the beast won't obey.
asEn.shi: Don't laugh, sir, the donkey just won't go.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't stand behind the donkey!
asEn.seng: Master, lend us your Buddha's power to make it go.

beats.en: You pull in front, I'll push behind!
Move! Move, or I'll sell you!

beats.text: 這一車太重，驢也拉不動。
beats.en: This load's too heavy, even for the donkey.

beats.text: 這畜生，比主家還難伺候。
beats.en: This beast is harder to please than the master.

beats.text: 還沒走成呢，牠就是不動。
beats.en: Still stuck. It just won't move.

as.guan: 官人見笑，還沒走成。

asEn.guan: Forgive the show, sir, we're still stuck.

beats.en: Hold some hay out in front to lead it.

beats.text: 這叫串車，前頭驢拽，後頭人推。
beats.en: That's a string cart: donkey pulls in front, men push behind.
It's moving! Moving! Easy now.
Make way! Grain sacks coming through!

as.guan: 官人讓讓，驢馱著糧進城。
as.shi: 相公小心，莫叫袋子蹭了衣裳。
as.jun: 軍爺，糧是送進城的，莫攔。

asEn.guan: By your leave, sir: donkeys taking grain into town.
asEn.shi: Careful, sir, don't let the sacks brush your robe.
asEn.fu: Keep to the side, madam; donkeys don't look.
asEn.tong: Kid, don't stand in front of the donkey!
asEn.seng: Excuse me, Master, the sacks are heavy.
asEn.jun: Soldier, the grain's for town; don't stop us.

beats.text: 這兩袋，是碼頭上剛卸的。
beats.en: These two sacks were just unloaded at the wharf.

beats.text: 驢兒驢兒，你馱的是米麼？
beats.en: Donkey, donkey, is that rice you carry?
It's grain, going into town.

beats.text: 城裏糧價又漲，這趟賺得著。
beats.en: Grain's dearer in town again; this trip will pay.

beats.text: 又是你？這袋糧要送去正店。
beats.en: You again? This grain goes to a licensed wine house.

as.guan: 官人又來了？糧是送正店釀酒的。

asEn.guan: Back again, sir? The grain's for a wine house's brewing.

beats.en: Through the gate, there's tax to pay.

beats.text: 那邊那頭驢，往別處走了！
beats.en: That other donkey's going the other way!
Go and stop it!
Please, call that porter back!

as.guan: 官人恕擾，前頭那挑擔的……
as.tong: 小哥兒，替我喊那貨郎一聲。
as.li: 兄弟，喊住前頭那挑擔的！

asEn.guan: Pardon me, sir, that porter ahead…
asEn.fu: Madam, would you call that pedlar back?
asEn.tong: Little one, give that pedlar a shout for me.

beats.en: Calling me, sir? What do you need?
How much for what hangs on your frame?
Daddy, buy me one!

beats.text: 小哥兒好眼力，挑一樣罷。
beats.en: Sharp eyes, little one. Pick one.

beats.text: 這孩子，見了貨郎就走不動。
beats.en: This child can't walk past a pedlar.

as.guan: 官人見笑，孩子纏人。

asEn.guan: Forgive us, sir, the child pesters me.

beats.en: Just one, only one!
Cheap for you, for good luck.
Fine, buy him one.

beats.text: 剪子、梳子、針頭線腦，都有！
beats.en: Scissors, combs, needles and thread, all here!

as.guan: 官人瞧瞧，小物件，樣樣有。
as.shi: 相公，裁紙的小刀要不要？
as.fu: 娘子，新到的梳子，挑一把？

asEn.guan: Have a look, sir: small things, all sorts.
asEn.shi: Sir, a little knife for cutting paper?
asEn.fu: Madam, new combs in. Pick one?
asEn.tong: Kid, don't touch, you'll cut yourself!

beats.en: That stack of bowls, how much?
Ten to a stack, cheap for you.
A bit cheaper and I'll take a stack too.

beats.text: 這攤子都擺到橋腳下了。
beats.en: Stalls right up to the foot of the bridge.
What else would you like?

as.guan: 官人還要甚麼？包好送府上。

asEn.guan: Anything else, sir? I'll wrap it and send it over.

beats.en: These scissors: is the steel good?
If they're not good, they're free!

altsEn: Make way! The master's sedan is coming up!
The sedan's coming through, clear off!

alts: 該你們讓！馬下坡停不住！
altsEn: You give way! A horse can't stop going downhill!
Back down! The official's horse goes first!
Back off, there's no getting past at the crown!
How can we back down with a sedan? You give way!
With a sedan on our shoulders we can't back up!
Easy up a slope, hard to back down one!
Clear off! The horse is spooked!
What's the fuss? Make them give way.
With this row, the bridge is jammed worse.
Wait. Nobody's getting across for a while.
You'd block a civil official's sedan?
My master holds office at court!

alts: 我家官人也不是好惹的！
altsEn: Our master's no man to cross either!
Is a military officer no official, then?
Brace it! Brace against the beam!
You ahead, to the side! Big boat coming!
To the left! Pole to the left!
The current's too strong, can't hold!
Don't let this bundle go in the river!
This trip will be the death of me.
Push the stern off! Don't touch the bank!
Heads down, heads down, we're going under.
They're throwing a rope from the bridge!
Someone up there's throwing a rope!
The man on the roof's caught it!
Let out more! They can't reach!
I've got this end, don't worry!
You on the roof! Grab the rope!
The mast! The mast's going to hit!
Brace a pole on the bridge!
What's the use of shouting? Can they hear?
Voices and water, all one din.

alts: 這竿子遞下去，夠得著麼？
altsEn: Will this pole reach if I pass it down?
You in front, duck your head!
Careful, don't push anyone in the river.
What a big boat, such a tall mast!
That mast is taller than the bridge!
There's a row over there too.
The sedan and the horse are at a standoff.

alts: 一邊船，一邊轎，今日好熱鬧。
altsEn: A boat on one side, a sedan on the other: what a day.
Trouble above and below the bridge.

alts: 趴在欄干上，看得最清楚。
altsEn: Leaning on the railing, I see best.
The fast water makes my eyes swim.
Let me see too, you in front.
That big boat is coming at us!
I'm watching: still a pole's length off.
Not even a boat ride is peaceful.
Tell the boatman to pole us away!
You there! Lower the mast, quick!
No use shouting, they can't hear!
The big boat's going to hit the bridge?

alts: 咱們泊在這裏，倒是穩當。
altsEn: Watching others pole is good fun.
Lots of moored boats ahead, careful!
Got it! Keep to the middle!
Deep water, keep to the middle.
Still a long way to go.

alts: 再搖一程，到了碼頭再歇。
altsEn: Scull a bit more; rest at the wharf.
This tow line gets heavier and heavier.
You on the bank, slow down! Boat ahead!
Pull slower, the bow will hit!
Sitting on the cargo is pleasant enough.
Watching them pull wears me out.
Patience; we go when the wind's fair.
What a racket over by the bridge.
Whose boat is in trouble now?
My legs have gone numb from sitting.
Soon; past the Rainbow Bridge it's close.
Not far now. Bear it a little longer.
In town, first a measure of wine.
They say the town's wine houses are lively.
This jar's heavy, hold it steady!
Put it here, line them up.
Break a jar and you pay for it.
Out of the way, I've a load on my back.
So much a bale: don't miscount.
Finish today and we'll collect our pay.
Lift the mat, the cargo's under it.
A whole day of bales for three hundred cash.
This new wine's good, another measure!
Drink slowly, sir, the food is coming.
This wine goes to the head…

alts: 樓下那串車上，蓋的甚麼？
altsEn: What's covered on that cart below?
Look at the bridge: packed solid.
This table comes to half a string.
Lamb wine, eighty cash a measure.
The river from upstairs: the best view.
Too many boats on the river to count.
The food's ready, take it out.
Take this pot of wine to the front.
Standing half a day; my legs ache.
That front table's been drinking half the day.
The tavern across the river: very grand.
Look how high they've built that festive gate.
That's a tavern: a place to spend money.
Full. I'll sit a little longer.
Rest your feet under the parasol!

alts: 莫喊了，人都看大船去了。
altsEn: Stop calling; everyone's gone to see the big boat.
Everyone's squeezing onto the bridge today.
Minding the stall sitting down: easy enough.
Hot sun; lucky we have a parasol.

alts: 屏風蓋嚴了，莫露出字來。
altsEn: Cover it all with the screen, don't let the writing show.

alts: 好好一扇字屏，拿來當苫布。
altsEn: A fine calligraphy screen, used as a tarp.
Such fine writing. What a waste.
Loaded. Let's push it out of town.
One more bundle, inside the shop.
Court business. Not for us to judge.
Don't brood; the cart comes first.
These few cash, for one bottle.
This is all I have. Enough?
Not a drop will leak, I promise.
Bottles for your new wine, buy them here!
Bottles and jars for wine, cheap!
Hot, just out of the pot!

alts: 今日橋上人多，生意好罷？
altsEn: Crowds on the bridge today; business good?
I'll buy one in a bit.
How much for what hangs on your frame?
Wait a moment, let me look.
This soup's hot; warms you through.

alts: 你看橋上，那轎子堵住了。
坐這裏，橋上橋下都看得見。
altsEn: Look at the bridge: that sedan's blocking it.
From here you see above and below the bridge.
This bowl's chipped, knock some off.
All right, all right, one cash off.
I'll take a stack too; ring them up together.
Hide from the sun under the parasol.
Can't budge it! The donkey's balking!

alts: 這畜生，偏偏今日鬧脾氣。
到了城裏，非賣了牠不可。
altsEn: This beast picks today to sulk.
Once in town, I'm selling it.

alts: 前頭驢拽，後頭人推，這才叫串車。
altsEn: Donkey pulls in front, men push behind: that's a string cart.
Hot herbal drink, a few cash a cup!
Let me put my load down.
Boiled from herbs: sweet with a bitter edge.
Bitter first, sweet after; it perks you up.
I've still a few cash on me.
A sedan and a horse are stuck on the bridge.
There's a row ahead; we can't get through.
The donkey's tired too; let's rest.
Hold it steady, don't frighten the donkey.
This bundle's crooked; tie it again.
I've got it, you tie it.
So crowded on the bridge, it's scared too.
Crowds make even a donkey timid.
Coiled and ready, sold by the bundle!
Look at the goods, cheapest at the bridgehead!
My arm aches from holding the parasol.
A gust, and the parasol tips.

alts: 攤子擺在橋口，生意才好。
altsEn: Set up at the bridgehead: that's where trade is.
Nowhere to move, too many people.
What are they shouting over there?
To town, this way, don't wander!
Keep the grain sack steady, don't drop it!
I know, this donkey knows the way.
The sack's bigger than the donkey!

alts: 碼頭上卸的糧，一袋袋往城裏送。
城裏正店，等著這糧釀酒。
altsEn: Grain off the wharf, sack by sack into town.
The town's wine houses are waiting to brew with it.
Grain prices change by the day.
Hold it long enough and you'll profit.
Anything on the rack, take your pick.
Straighten them, so nobody knocks them over.

alts: 這攤子靠著欄干，倒穩當。
altsEn: Leaning on the railing, this stall's steady.
The crowd's pushing in; mind the rack.
The bridge mouth is narrow enough, and here's another stall.
Stalls up on the bridge, and the road's gone.
Look at that big boat, it's going to hit!
It won't hit; they know what they're doing.

alts: 撞了，咱們這棚子也遭殃。
altsEn: If it hits, this shed suffers too.

alts: 我跟你們說，這橋是個兵想的。
這橋沒柱子，船才過得去。
altsEn: Let me tell you: a soldier thought this bridge up.
No piers, that's why boats can get through.

alts: 橋上的人都探出身子了。
altsEn: They're throwing a rope from up there!
Everyone on the bridge is leaning out.
Oh, it makes my heart race.
Squatting here, I see it best.
Legs gone numb and still I won't leave.
The boats behind will have to wait.
Don't panic, the crew know their job.
With the mast down, she'll pass.
Shout yourself hoarse, it won't help.

alts: 這船要是撞了，可了不得。
altsEn: If that boat hits, it'll be a disaster.
A boat full of people; let nothing happen.
Put away the goods under the parasol!
The crowd's pressing in; pack the goods.
Forget the goods, watch the boat!

alts: 前頭那酒館，歇一歇再走。
altsEn: The bridge is jammed; we'll take the riverside.
Rest at the tavern ahead, then go on.

alts: 灶下的炭，是驢馱進來的。
altsEn: The charcoal under the stove came in on donkeys.
Hot charcoal warms the wine quickly.
The donkey trains from the country bring charcoal?

alts: 正是，一馱馱都送到酒店。
altsEn: Just so; load after load goes to the taverns.
Brought in from the country: good charcoal.
Hot wine and food, to take away too!

alts: 桌子都空著，人都看船去了。
altsEn: A measure by the river: just right.
The tables are empty; everyone's off watching the boat.
Close to the bridge here; you can see it all.
Quite a din under the bridge just now.
Sit and have a bowl of tea; don't join the crush.
Why push? You can see from here.
Keeper, whisk another cup of tea.
Sitting on the ground is cool enough.
Can't see; I only hear shouting.
There's more in the jar, take your time.
That big boat: has it got through?
What's the row by the bridge now?

guan: By your leave, sir, the snacks are hot!
tong: Out of the way, kid, don't knock it over!

guan: Sir, a look in the basket?
fu: Madam, pick a few to take home?

altsEn: Have a look, have a look!
Fine goods, held up for you to see!
Can I get through this way?
Coming through! Don't knock the jar!
The sack's not heavy, just long.
Heavy load on my back, make way!
Don't shove! The sack will fall!
This bridge is more crowded than a market.
Easier once I'm off the bridge.
Let's see how long you'll argue.
I'll just fold my arms and watch.
Civil and military, neither gives way.

alts: 橋上亂成這樣，也無人管。
攤子佔了街，越發不像話。
altsEn: Chaos on the bridge, and nobody in charge.
Stalls taking over the street, worse and worse.
The sun's in my eyes, can't see.
These two buckets go to the tavern.

alts: 今日橋上，比廟會還熱鬧。
altsEn: The bridge is busier than a temple fair today.
Nothing at the counter; I'll watch the fuss.
Cool under the parasol, come and sit!

guan: Rest a while, sir; it's cool under the parasol.

altsEn: One pot of tea, half a day's sitting.
